name: Scripts
description: Runs your own scripts when things happen in Aurral. List scripts under each event below. The two switches under Adds, notification and download.finished, are how Aurral tells this plugin something happened. Leave both on. To skip an event, leave its scripts blank.

settings.label: Scripts folder
settings.help: The folder that holds your scripts, as Aurral sees it, for example /scripts. Only files inside it can run. Mount it read-only. Select Test to list the scripts in it.

settings.label: Discover updated
settings.help: When the daily Discover recommendations refresh. Script names, separated by commas, for example notify.sh, scan.py. Select Test to see the names in your folder. Leave blank to run nothing. Needs notification on under Adds.

settings.label: Flow finished
settings.help: When a flow finishes its downloads. Script names, separated by commas. Needs notification on under Adds.

settings.label: Request made
settings.help: When someone requests an album. Script names, separated by commas. Needs notification on under Adds.

settings.label: Request available
settings.help: When a requested album is downloaded, or was already on disk. Script names, separated by commas. Needs notification on under Adds.

settings.label: Artist added
settings.help: When someone adds an artist to the Library. Script names, separated by commas. Needs notification on under Adds.

settings.label: Track added
settings.help: Once for each track Aurral adds to the Library, flow tracks included. Script names, separated by commas. Needs download.finished on under Adds.

settings.label: Timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long a script may run before it and everything it started are stopped. Default 60, up to 3600.

settings.label: Test runs the scripts
settings.help: When on, Test also runs every script listed above once, with the event scriptTest and sample values.
